mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000 and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY < -10% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM > 1% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight labor market with high interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with low unemployment
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY < -2% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE MoM > 0.5% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it signals a slowing economy with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY < 2% and FEDFUNDS > 3% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
